raw.notable_prerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Twinflame
raw.steps:
Cast Twinflame by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Twinflame, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

raw.notable_prerequisites: Delina does not have summoning sickness.
produces: Infinite tapped creature tokens until end of turn
raw.steps:
Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one nonlegendary token copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Activate a Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a copy of the nonlegendary Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat from step 3.

raw.steps:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2}, casting a copy of Final Fortune without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Final Fortune, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of each extra turn's end step, Final Fortune triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, ending the turn.
Repeat.

raw.steps:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2}, casting a copy of Final Fortune.
At the beginning of your next end step, if you cast Final Fortune on the previous turn, Final Fortune's lose the game ability triggers.
In response, activate Obeka by tapping it, choosing to end the turn and exiling the stack in the process.
Repeat each turn.
